status: PREREGISTERED before any alternative mesh is generated; geometry only; zero physical FEM; no GO; no new accepted state

target.definition: signed-MTS 4-mm forecast g2_lp2_forecast(soft1 S9 STATE, LP2-A3 policy) at full precision; must equal the stored FAILED_MESH.mat polyline and the soft1 TERMINAL candidate bitwise
target.nominalClearanceGeometry: clearanceGeometry of the accepted soft1 S9 STATE

references.polyline: accepted soft1 S9 STATE polyline_mm and tangent
references.baselineMesh: original accepted soft1 S9 MESH.mat (0.45 mm)

references.polyline: accepted H S10 STATE polyline_mm and tangent
references.baselineMesh: original accepted H S10 MESH.mat (0.45 mm)

mesher.function: g2_lp2a2_join (unchanged; LP2-A2 source digest f1d7e4d6...) followed by g2_lp2a2_pairing_audit, exactly as rung k of g2_lp2a2_mesh

gates.join: 13/13 inherited join gates (min angle >= 20 deg, neighbour ratio <= 1.8, T3 <= 40000, seams, banks, q 2443 inside core, ...)
gates.independentMetrics: g2_lp2b1_metrics agrees with the join summary (T3, min angle 1e-10 deg, max ratio 1e-12)
gates.kinkedAudit: g2_lp1_audit: g2_kinked_mesh_auditor 34/34, T3 budget, bank adapter, four-mask phase audit, owner re-map
gates.clearance: actual-polygon clearance and the 1-mm guide-to-every-ring guard (g2_lp2a3_classify) = MATRIX_ADVANCE; nominal clearance on the parent geometry = MATRIX_ADVANCE
gates.protected: block T3 rows 1-2916 (core 2788 + collar 128), block nodes, T6 block rows and nodes, nodal q on the block and 2443 active q parents identical to the baseline; every inherited q annulus inside the 3 mm core
gates.geometry: exact polyline; tangent equal to the input within 1e-12

stoppingRules.progress: generate the next candidate ONLY if the previous one failed the join with failed gates contained in {globalMinAngleAtLeast20, globalNeighborRatioAtMost1p8}
stoppingRules.hold: any other failure (admissibility, CAD, seeds, budget, any other join gate, pairing, kinked audit, phase, owner map, chords, clearance, guard, protected-array difference, error) stops with HOLD; no further candidate
stoppingRules.selection: the first candidate passing EVERY gate is selected prospectively; no physical result is used
stoppingRules.exhausted: if all three fail the quality gates: HOLD with full diagnostics and a proposal (not an implementation) of a separate local transition repair

determinism: one geometry-only repeat of the selected spacing on the target in a new MATLAB session; canonical arrays (X3, T3, X6, T6, banks, q, rows, polyline, CAD point vertices, tip node), canonical SHA-256 and gates must be identical (MAT bytes are not compared); otherwise HOLD
referenceRule: the SAME selected spacing on soft1 S9 and H S10 only, all gates above with the original accepted MESH as baseline; a reference failure is HOLD for scientific disposition; the target selection is never changed afterwards
outputs: outputs/g2_lp2b1_geometry_v1/<attempt> in the execution clone: distinct attempt names (T_soft1_S10_h040, ..., *_REPEAT, R_<ref>_h0xx), never overwritten; no record under any historical run or ledger root
resources: pre-start check >= 8.2 GiB free with the removable backup present before MATLAB starts; g2_lp0_preflight 5 GiB guard unchanged; one MATLAB process
excluded: physical FEM, GO, new accepted state, LP2-A3 retry/resumption, other spacings, smaller steps, guide-radius change, threshold change, LP2-B2, S12, merges
